description: This file declares a class `SuperImageRebuilder` inheriting from `SetupFeature`, and a function `SuperImageNeedsRebuilding` that checks if a super image needs rebuilding. It also defines a Fruit component for dependency injection. The file includes configuration headers related to Cuttlefish and features.

classes.name: SuperImageRebuilder
classes.description: A class representing a feature for super image rebuilding, inheriting from SetupFeature.

methods.name: SuperImageRebuilderComponent
methods.description: Creates and returns a Fruit dependency injection component with required configurations and the SuperImageRebuilder feature.

methods.name: SuperImageNeedsRebuilding
methods.description: Function to determine whether the super image needs rebuilding, based on fetcher configuration and zip file paths.
